objects.name: Analytic 1860
objects.description: Real-time network monitoring identifies a source issuing read-only Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol requests to multiple field devices at a polling rate exceeding the legitimate Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) baseline, from a source not in the approved control server allowlist. Because the action is read-only, source-identity and rate deviation are the only available distinguishing signals. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
